sources.label: MHRA October safety roundup
sources.method: Ordinary public web reader; no access bypass
sources.result: Published and issued October 27, 2026. Selected contents, antidepressant and news sections reviewed. Repeats October 15 antidepressant communication. Ioflupane section describes venlafaxine-associated false-positive DAT interpretation, limited evidence for other SNRIs, unclear mechanism. New communication of older diagnostic interaction, not new tic-treatment signal; UK label revision date not verified. Tracked product-link route failed HTTP 400, not a broken canonical product record.
sources.limitations: Selected relevant sections and identifiers only; original summary, no source document retained.

sources.label: CSACI position statement
sources.method: Ordinary public web reader; no access bypass
sources.result: Published July 26, 2012; DOI 10.1186/1710-1492-8-12; PMID 22835332. Food-specific IgG is not validated to diagnose adverse food reactions; exposure/tolerance alternative and potential harm of inappropriate restriction/reintroduction. Historical society position, not a new tic finding.
